vulnerability.explanation: On VMS builds, opt_path_end() has the same pre-decrement pattern. With an empty filename, it returns filename-1. opt_progname() then calls strrchr(p, '.') at line 110 on this invalid pointer, resulting in an out-of-bounds read. This can be triggered by passing an empty string to opt_progname().
